description: Source code for Zend Framework's cURL adapter class implementing Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Interface, handling HTTP requests via cURL.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Curl
classes.description: Implements HTTP client adapter using cURL extension for Zend Framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Checks if cURL extension is loaded; throws exception if not.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration options for the cURL adapter.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initializes cURL session and connects to specified host and port, with SSL options if secure.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request with specified method, URI, headers, and body using cURL.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Returns the server response stored after a request.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the cURL session and resets connection info.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Ensures cURL session is closed upon object destruction.
